subject: Flashbacks
body:
Melbot says you built a machine that grows spare bodies. Please be careful, mate. Remember my cloning machine? One dog went in and seven bones came out. It took a whole revival machine to put him back together, and he’s been a skeleton ever since.

So please don’t put Grim in yours. He still hasn’t forgiven me. If you’re going to do it anyway, at least set it up properly. @display:integrated_boogaloo:guide/body_shop

Your old friend,
Dr. T
